title: Geometry of three--generated ideals in the plane
summary: We study the geometry of parameter spaces of homogeneous ideals in k[x,y,z] minimally generated by three forms of the same degree, stratified by the degree of their base scheme and by the initial degree of their syzygies. We realize these strata through Quot and Hilbert schemes, construct universal families of Bourbaki schemes, and prove smoothness and irreducibility results for the free loci.
